graph.title: Build a robot (HTML & CSS)
notes: This tutorial is a software-only HTML/CSS project: images (face, eyes1-3, mouth1) are positioned on a web page with CSS.
It has no physical parts (no breadboard, jumper wires, Arduino or Raspberry Pi GPIO wiring), so the build graph is empty.
The matched PARTS list was empty, and the catalogue parts (breadboard, jumper-wire, jumper-wire-mf) are not used.
The web page images are not physical parts, so they are not modelled as nodes.

breadboard.name: Solderless breadboard
breadboard.port_rule: Holes are named '<column><bank>.<row>': column 1-30, bank 't' (top half, rows a-e) or 'b' (bottom half, rows f-j), e.g. '12t.c', '7b.h'. The 5 holes of one column-bank are one strip. Power rails: 'tp.<n>', 'tn.<n>', 'bp.<n>', 'bn.<n>' (each rail is one strip).
